Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Class FaceSearchResult

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.search.FaceSearchResult
public final class FaceSearchResult extends java.lang.Object
Final result for each search round. SPOOF_DETECTED may include a qualifying identity match but remains a liveness rejection. Check the end reason first. For MATCH_FOUND/TIMEOUT, then check whether each face's similarity reaches the threshold.

  • Method Details

    • getFrameJpeg

      @Nullable public byte[] getFrameJpeg()
      Complete RGB scene JPEG from the round's terminal sample, quality 95. Proportionally reduced so that neither dimension exceeds 480; never enlarged. Rotated and unmirrored, from the same sample as getFrame(). Face boxes still use coordinates from before this reduction. Both successful and failed business results attempt to include an image. Null means no valid image, insufficient memory, or encoding failure; old images are not reused. Each read returns an independent copy. The SDK does not create files or retain image history.

    • getFrameWidth

    • getFrameHeight

      JPEG height in pixels; 0 if no JPEG.

    • getEndReason

      @NonNull public FaceSearchResult.EndReason getEndReason()
      The final outcome takes priority over similarity. SPOOF_DETECTED is not a pass even when the face library reports a match.

    • getLivenessScore

      @Nullable public java.lang.Float getLivenessScore()
      Single-frame passive-liveness score from the current result frame, in [0,1]. Valid rejection scores, including 0, are returned. Null when liveness is disabled, in M:N mode, or when no valid score is available by the deadline. Scores are not reused from another frame. SPOOF_DETECTED expresses rejection; the score is for application records, without another threshold comparison.

    • getFrame

      @NonNull public FaceSearchFrame getFrame()
      Return the sample frame that produced this final result. Use frameId to associate display records; it is not necessarily the newest camera frame.
